zh-CN.title: ACP 外部 Agent
zh-CN.description: 通过统一子任务入口委派 ACP Agent，共享容量、取消和超时管理。

usage.title: 安装并配置 worker
usage.description: 由部署方先安装并认证 ACP 程序，再按包内指南安装扩展，为已有 ACP Agent 配置 worker 别名并重启 Gateway。

usage.title: 委派子任务
usage.description: 启用父 Agent 的子任务能力并允许该别名。外部自报用量和未验证验收条件会保留来源。

en-US.title: ACP external agents
en-US.description: Delegate to ACP agents through unified tasks with shared capacity, cancellation and deadlines.

usage.title: Install and configure a worker
usage.description: Install and authenticate the ACP program separately. Follow the package guide to install the extension, assign a worker alias and restart Gateway.

usage.title: Delegate a task
usage.description: Enable subagents for the parent and allow the alias. External usage remains self-reported and acceptance criteria remain unverified.
